ai.title: CLI agent modes simplified to work/review
ai.summary: Internal `.agents` CLI agent modes renamed from `test` to `work`, with `review` kept. `create-cli-agent.ts` and `cli-agent-prompts.ts` updated to support `defaultMode`, `workModeInstructions`, and `reviewModeInstructions` overrides. `cli-agent-schemas.ts` renames `testResults` to `results` and `testName` to `name`. `cli-agent-types.ts` fixes `ExtraInputParams` type to properly exclude `mode` via key remapping.

eli5.text: The internal helper that runs automated coding agents now calls its two working styles "work" and "review" instead of the old "test" name, and it defaults to the "work" style when you don't pick one. If you configure one of these agents today, you can also hand it custom instructions for each style and set which style is the default, and the agent's saved output now files its findings under "results" instead of "testResults". This only touches the behind-the-scenes tooling used to build and check our own CLI, so outside developers won't see it change their apps.

ai.title: setoutput tool collapsed by default in CLI
ai.summary: CLI now renders set_output tool blocks collapsed by default. New shouldCollapseToolByDefault helper in cli/src/utils/constants.ts checks COLLAPSED_BY_DEFAULT_TOOL_NAMES. ToolBranch component uses this helper to determine initial collapse state when toolBlock.isCollapsed is undefined. Reduces visual noise from verbose set_output JSON payloads.

eli5.text: When you interact with an assistant that runs commands and reports results, the detailed output from status-reporting commands now appears folded up by default instead of shown in full. This affects only the status-reporting blocks in the command-line interface, which can otherwise dump long JSON text and clutter your screen; you can still expand any of them whenever you want to see what's inside.

ai.title: CLI: cancelled status for interrupted subagents
ai.summary: Added 'cancelled' status to AgentContentBlock. markRunningAgentsAsCancelled recursively updates 'running' blocks on interruption. UI displays '⊘ cancelled' in red. Files: types/chat.ts, utils/block-operations.ts, utils/agent-helpers.ts, hooks/helpers/send-message.ts.

eli5.text: When you press Ctrl+C to stop an agent that's running inside the conversation, it now shows as '⊘ cancelled' in red instead of sitting in a 'running' state. Only the agent blocks that were actively running get marked cancelled, and nested subagents are handled recursively. This is live today.
